camel_example: aliyun sas CreateCycleTask --region cn-hangzhou --TargetEndTime 6 --TaskName EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN --TaskType VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN --IntervalPeriod 7 --FirstDateStr 1650556800000 --Enable 1 --TargetStartTime 0 --PeriodUnit day
description_en: Creates a periodic scan task, including image scan, emergency vulnerability scanning, and virus scan
description_zh: 创建周期性扫描任务，包括镜像扫描、应急漏洞扫描及病毒扫描
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-cycle-task --task-name EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN --task-type VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN --period-unit day --interval-period 7 --first-date-str 1650556800000 --target-start-time 0 --target-end-time 6 --enable 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCycleTask

parameters.help_en:
The task name. Valid values:
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: virus scan.
IMAGE_SCAN: image scan.
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: emergency vulnerability scanning
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称。
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：病毒扫描。
IMAGE_SCAN：镜像扫描。
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：应急漏洞扫描
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: virus scan.
IMAGE_SCAN: image scan.
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: emergency vulnerability scanning
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：病毒扫描。
IMAGE_SCAN：镜像扫描。
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：应急漏洞扫描
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the scan interval. Valid values:
day: day.
hour: hour
parameters.help_zh:
扫描周期的单位，取值：
day：天。
hour：小时
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The task start time, in hours
parameters.name: target_start_time

parameters.help_en: The task end time, in hours
parameters.name: target_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
1: enabled.
0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
1：开启

parameters.help_en: The source from which the task is added

parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token
